**Verdict: PASS. I raised no new findings, and all three of my round-1 findings are fixed (CLOSED_VERIFIED).** **Candidate check.** The candidate ID `sha256:5df44203…186b` (2203 files) matches in the repository and in a complete disposable clone. HEAD is `7144a19`, the freeze commit. Its only changes after source `edbf5ce` are the three assignments, the candidate manifest and `stages.json`, so the product I reviewed is `edbf5ce`'s. **My round-1 findings, re-run on the real demo stack in en and ar:** | Finding | Severity | Result | |---|---|---| | F-DG5-120: a dependency slip's forecast impact reached no screen | Medium | **Fixed.** The affected owner's My Work item now reads "Critical dependency DEP-01 slipped (calendar days late: 5); forecast impact on INI-01". Its link opens the Dependencies page. That page and INI-01's page show the forecast finish moving 25 Feb → 2 Mar 2027 (+5), which matches the API exactly. In ar the arrows run right to left and both slips are listed. On the production stack, forecasts that can't be computed show "Unknown", never 0. | | F-DG5-121: the demo plan had no Day-90 test | Low | **Fixed.** The test now exists (scheduled 2026-10-01, start + 90 days). The page shows the six B0136–B0141 questions verbatim, and a question can be answered (1/6). | | F-DG5-122: reader tables showed raw Markdown and clipped callouts | Low | **Fixed.** No reader view shows Markdown table syntax or a literal `
`. The B0016 and B0124 callouts wrap with no horizontal overflow at 1280 px and at 390 px. | **Full review runs:** - **Validators:** `--register DG5` and the historical DG4, DG3, DG2 and DG1 checks all pass. - **Build:** all packages build (exit 0). - **Root acceptance, production stack:** 30/30 passed. - **Integration:** 278/278 passed, including the new demo Day-90 test. - **Unit:** 69/69 and 132/132 passed. - **Source fidelity:** my analyser reports ALL OK. B0004, B0016, B0124, B0134, B0136–B0141, B0147 (the three chains), B0150 and B0152 are verbatim, and there are twelve walkthrough steps. - **Exports:** all 22 exports (five formats, en and ar) carry B0004 (the Arabic rendering in ar files) and the synthetic label. None names DG0–DG7 or claims PMI status, and the Arabic files are RTL. - **Production isolation:** the production database holds no demo records or users, and seed-demo is refused in production mode and on a non-empty database. - **Navigation:** areas are hidden server-side by permission (3, 14, 13, 14 and 2 areas for the five dev users). **Failures in my logs.** These came from my own harness, not the product: - I started two Playwright runs in the same clone, and the second run's start wiped `test-results/`, deleting the first run's trace files (ENOENT). - Three tests failed this way: the demo-users walkthrough in en (it had finished all twelve steps), p5-forms T14 in en (its two serial siblings then didn't run), and p5-navigation in ar. - Re-running those specs alone with their own output directory passed 2/2 and 10/10. - All of this is disclosed in the record. **Judgements:** - I accept D-163 (a), D-164 (a)–(k), D-165 and its accepted observations, D-166 Rules A and B, D-167 and D-168. - I accept the RG1 handbacks' two disclosed limits: the roadmap has no slip overlay, and the launch form isn't filtered per procedure. Neither breaks an acceptance text. - The Studio badges G1–G6 as a custom extension. That matches B0160, so it is not a defect. - The environmental residuals (live registry, live CI, Keycloak/real demo IdP, AI and notification adapters) are recorded as PASS on the offline surface, with the residuals named. **Files:** - `docs/delivery/reviews/DG5/round-2/domain-reviewer.json` (checked against the review schema; all 78 requirements listed) - `docs/delivery/reviews/DG5/round-2/domain-reviewer.verifications.json` - Evidence, with EN and AR screenshots: `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG5/domain/round-2/rg2/` I removed the disposable clone and scratch directories afterwards.
